content.value_statement: Roadmap changes can become inconsistent across local planning files and ClickUp. This skill explains a clear mapping, setup process, and safe synchronization workflow using the official ClickUp MCP.
actual_capabilities: Maps local epics and milestones to ClickUp tasks and subtasks.
Explains local ClickUp configuration fields and sync mappings.
Lists setup, push, pull, sync, status, link, and unlink commands.
Provides the official ClickUp MCP installation endpoint.
Describes OAuth authentication through the MCP interface.
States conflict rules for status, points, and titles.
limitations: It documents a workflow but does not implement synchronization logic.
It requires a configured ClickUp account and authorized official MCP service.
It does not resolve conflicts beyond the stated field-level rules.
It does not validate local roadmap data or ClickUp permissions.

use_cases.title: Connect a new roadmap
use_cases.description: Configure a local roadmap project to map epics and milestones to an existing ClickUp workspace.

use_cases.title: Publish planned work
use_cases.description: Review remote changes, preview updates, and push approved local roadmap changes to ClickUp.

use_cases.title: Resolve sync differences
use_cases.description: Use the documented conflict rules when local planning data and ClickUp task fields differ.

prompt_templates.title: Install the MCP
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me install the official ClickUp MCP and explain the OAuth authentication step.

prompt_templates.title: Map my roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to map my local epics and milestones to ClickUp tasks and subtasks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a safe push
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checklist to pull changes, run a dry run, check status, and push my roadmap to ClickUp.

prompt_templates.title: Plan conflict handling
prompt_templates.prompt: My local title and ClickUp status changed. Apply this skill's conflict rules and explain the expected result.

output_examples.input: How should a local milestone appear in ClickUp?
output_examples.output: A milestone is represented as a subtask under its related Epic task in ClickUp.

output_examples.input: What should I do before pushing roadmap updates?
output: Preview changes with a dry run.
Check sync status before confirming the push.

output_examples.input: Which side wins when statuses conflict?
output_examples.output: ClickUp wins for status because it represents the current state.

best_practices: Pull remote changes before creating a push.
Use a dry run and review the proposed updates.
Verify OAuth scopes and ClickUp permissions before authorizing the MCP.
anti_patterns: Do not push changes without reviewing remote updates.
Do not assume all fields use the same conflict rule.
Do not authorize an MCP endpoint without verifying its source and OAuth scopes.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It explains how to connect a local roadmap with ClickUp through the official ClickUp MCP.

faq.question: How are epics represented in ClickUp?
faq.answer: A local epic maps to a ClickUp task with the Epic type.

faq.question: How are milestones represented in ClickUp?
faq.answer: A local milestone maps to a subtask under its related Epic.

faq.question: What should I do before pushing updates?
faq.answer: Pull remote changes, use a dry run, and check the sync status.

faq.question: How does status conflict resolution work?
faq.answer: ClickUp wins for status conflicts because it represents the current state.

faq.question: Does this skill perform synchronization itself?
faq.answer: No. It documents the setup, commands, mapping, and conflict rules for the workflow.
